_about: M17a: big projects. Each has a site (placed by the world), phases done in order, and a reward. A phase needs its items delivered (from your pockets or a storage crate within deliver_range of the site), then work_hours of game-time work while you stand within work_radius of the site; the work is a continuous noise source at loudness while it runs. A phase with watts also needs that much spare power on a network the site is on (a pole within reach). Projects.gd reads this; GameData checks it.

phases.name: Patch the tank
phases.start: You start patching the tank. The hammering rings across the park.

phases.name: Fix the pipes
phases.start: You start on the pipes. Metal on metal, loud.

phases.name: Run the pump
phases.start: The tower pump is running. Everything can hear it.
phases.done: The water tower is running: rain collectors fill three times as fast, and you can build a water tap.
